name: s3Move
syntax: s3Move(srcBucketName, srcObjectName, trgBucketName [, trgObjectName, acl, location, accessKeyId, secretAccessKey, host, timeout])
description: Moves an object to another bucket or key, by copying it and then deleting the source.

params.name: trgObjectName
params.description: The target object key. Defaults to the source object key.

params.name: acl
params.description: An array of structs, one for each ACL grant.

params.name: accessKeyId
params.description: The S3 access key ID. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.accesskeyid` system property or environment variable.

params.name: secretAccessKey
params.description: The S3 secret access key. Defaults to the `lucee.s3.secretaccesskey` system property or environment variable.

params.name: host
params.description: The hostname of an S3-compatible provider, without `https://`. Defaults to Amazon AWS.

rustcfml.notes: Names the bucket and object arguments `srcBucket`, `srcObject`, `trgBucket` and `trgObject`, and the secret key argument `secretKey`. Doesn't list `location` or `timeout`, so `accessKeyId` is the sixth argument.

examples.title: Move an object to another bucket
examples.description: Copies the object to the target and deletes the source.
